title: React, Tailwind and first deploy
description: The site moves to React with Tailwind CSS and React Router, and is published on GitHub Pages for the first time.

title: New homepage and mini-game
description: The homepage is rewritten and the letter-grid game arrives.

title: Dark mode
description: Light/dark theme switch across every page.

title: Two languages and History page
description: Italian and English support with react-i18next, plus the first version of this page.

title: Creations page
description: First version of the Creations page, and an easter egg hidden in the logo.

title: About page
description: A page with profile, stack and interests.

title: v2.2.0
description: First tagged release: the project is reorganised by component type.

title: History in sections
description: The History page is split into sections and commits are grouped by type.

title: Trophies
description: Unlockable trophies, stored in the browser and tied to the game and navigation.

title: Community trophy
description: New "community" rarity with the Grid Filler trophy, an idea by LoreLuca.

title: v2.3.0
description: Reworked stats generation and reorganised documentation.

title: Vite and automated publishing
description: The build moves to Vite. A GitHub Actions workflow validates the dev branch, updates main, creates releases and publishes to GitHub Pages.

title: Clean URLs and SEO
description: Goodbye hash routing: normal URLs, prerendered pages and per-page metadata.
